plan: Build runie-tui: minimal ratatui/crossterm TUI for runie-core
objective: Replicate the user-visible TUI surface of grok-build's pager as simply as possible while subscribing to the runie-core event stream. Single-screen layout: scrollback transcript + prompt input + status bar. No auth, MCP, ACP, sub-agents, voice, plan-approval, worktrees, dashboard, persona picker, themes.
completionCriterion: All 10 step files marked done; cargo check/test green on runie-tui; an end-to-end test (TestBackend) drives a MockStreamFn + 2 tools and asserts the rendered Buffer shows user prompt, streaming assistant text, tool execution card, tool result, and final assistant text in that order.

steps.title: Scaffold runie-tui crate (Cargo.toml, deps, src layout)
Status bar: streaming / thinking / ready / error
Key handling: Enter, Ctrl+C cancel, Esc clear, Ctrl+D quit
App loop: select! over input + bus + loop tasks
